regions.text: |三形而上約稻對者の目の如くに投げ出された離接肢の一つが實存の全幅をゆり動かしながら寶存の中核へ體得されるのが運命である。離接肢は離接諸可能性の全破を豫想してゐる。

quote.translation: Fate is one of the disjuncts, thrown out like the pips of a die, being grasped in lived experience into the core of Existenz even as it shakes Existenz in its whole breadth.

regions.text: 然るに諸可能性の全體といふことは窮極約には形而上前絶對者の概念へ導く。絶對者は稻割者なるが故に絕對に一と考へられる。

quote.translation: A disjunct presupposes the whole of the disjunctive possibilities, and the whole of possibilities leads, in the last analysis, to the concept of the metaphysical absolute.

regions.text: また絶對約に一なるが故に絕對約に必然と思惟される。この絶對約必然を形而上的必然と呼ぶことができる。この概念は既にアリストラレスが形而上學」のうちに逃べた（Aristoteles,Met

quote.translation: The absolute, because it is the absolute, is thought as absolutely one, and because it is absolutely one, it is thought as absolutely necessary; this absolute necessity can be called metaphysical necessity.

quote.translation: Everything other than the unmoved mover is moved by another, and so "has the contingency of being otherwise" (ἐνδέχεται ἄλλως ἔχειν); it is, in other words, metaphysical contingency as the negation of metaphysical necessity.
